meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start with who decided that.
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. Now the zero itself: was Owen heard before it went into the gradebook, and on what basis?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, Hale, when, and under which section of your own procedure? Section 4.5 is for repeated concerns, and this is his first; it comes off today. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office at 4:40 and at the board after that.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"Just a note." Then take it off today and put that in writing to me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an answer on who decided it and whether Owen was heard first, and the note taken off his student file, confirmed to me in writing. I expect that note removed today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn and the note removed from Owen's file, while the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put on the table before the meeting ended.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though apologising again for the missed call earned one small sign of ground because it was short and didn't defend the process.
What cost ground: Telling her the concern was already noted in his file, then calling it meaningless, hit her one non-negotiable and locked her into her opening demands and the principal's office.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came anywhere near that night because no evidence was shown at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether Owen was heard and on what basis, answer with something dated from his own work that she can check herself, and hold back the file note until you can offer to remove it under 4.4.
